server.description: An ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agent-server entry, modeled on Zed's 'agent_servers' shape. No standard shared config format is published for ACP agent-server registration across clients (unlike MCP's de facto 'mcpServers' shape), so this is best-effort.

args.description: CLI arguments passed to 'command' (custom type only)

command.description: Executable to launch the ACP agent server (custom type only)

env.description: Environment variables passed to the launched process (custom type only)

type.description: 'registry' resolves the agent from the client's own ACP registry (e.g. Zed queries cdn.agentclientprotocol.com's registry.json at launch); 'custom' specifies the launch command directly.

description: ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agent-server config file: an 'agentServers' map. No standard cross-client file format exists for this yet, modeled on Zed's own 'agent_servers' settings.json shape.
title: ACP client config (agentServers)
